concept: External AppDB resource ownership migration with retained volumes
summary: Source-anchored research for External AppDB resource ownership migration with retained volumes. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: MongoDB documents an in-place transfer of the existing AppDB StatefulSet and its persistent storage to a MongoDB resource, without copying or recreating AppDB data. The MCK 1.12.0 release notes describe the same mechanism. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/tutorial/migrate-appdb-to-external.md ; https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-kubernetes/releases/tag/1.12.0

During this migration, spec.applicationDatabase.passwordSecretKeyRef is unsupported: the operator generates a new password and rotates any supplied password. Treat credential rotation as a migration effect even when the data volumes are retained. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Create a MongoDB resource named exactly <primary-om-name>-db with spec.role: AppDB before adding the Ops Manager external reference. Its ownership-related Pending phase is expected until spec.externalApplicationDatabaseRef triggers release of the existing StatefulSet. (low confidence)

On forward migration the operator detaches the StatefulSet by removing the Ops Manager resource's owner reference and marking the StatefulSet as ready for migration; the MongoDB resource then takes ownership of it. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/tutorial/migrate-appdb-to-external.md

Verify completion by checking that StatefulSet metadata.ownerReferences changes from MongoDBOpsManager/<primary-om-name> to MongoDB/<primary-om-name>-db, the MongoDB and Ops Manager phases reach Running, and Ops Manager status.applicationDatabase.phase becomes Disabled. Disabled means internal AppDB management stopped. (low confidence)

Preserving Ops Manager pod uptime depends on preserving its computed AppDB connection string and hostnames. The migration procedure supports the default replica-set port; non-default ports are unsupported. If AppDB pod templates or container sets differ, AppDB itself can be unavailable for one to two minutes even though the ownership transfer retains its data. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The AppDB migration re-points ownership of the StatefulSet and its Persistent Volumes, and the documented procedure verifies the change only through the StatefulSet's owner references. Kubernetes allows cluster-scoped dependents to specify only cluster-scoped owners, so a namespaced MongoDB resource cannot be a valid owner reference for a cluster-scoped PV. Sources: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/architecture/garbage-collection/ ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/tutorial/migrate-appdb-to-external.md

After the target resource is waiting, patch the primary Ops Manager resource with spec.externalApplicationDatabaseRef pointing to it using kind: MongoDB. This forward procedure does not require deleting either custom resource or the StatefulSet. (low confidence)

Once spec.externalApplicationDatabaseRef is set, spec.applicationDatabase no longer controls an internal AppDB for that Ops Manager resource. The migration patch may remove spec.applicationDatabase, but leaving it present has no effect. (low confidence)

The Application Database version set on the MongoDB resource must match the version the internally managed Application Database runs, and must be a MongoDB version that the management Ops Manager instance offers. If the MongoDB resource configuration differs from the internally managed Application Database configuration, the Application Database can be unavailable for one to two minutes. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/tutorial/migrate-appdb-to-external.md

The forward procedure re-points ownership of the existing StatefulSet and its Persistent Volumes without moving or recreating data. Red Hat documents that the Delete reclaim policy deletes both the PersistentVolume object and the associated external storage asset, whereas Retain allows manual reclamation. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/tutorial/migrate-appdb-to-external.md ; https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_dedicated/4/html/storage/understanding-persistent-storage
